name: Philly Cheesesteak
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
steps: Drizzle filet with olive oil and season with salt and black pepper. Sear in a cast-iron skillet over medium heat for 6 minutes per side. Remove and let rest 7 minutes before slicing into bite-size pieces. Keep warm.
Toss onion with a little olive oil and sauté in same pan until lightly browned around edges.
To serve, place a big scoop of steak into a hoagie roll. Top with onion and torn cheese. Serve.

culture.text: A cheesesteak is a sandwich made from thinly sliced pieces of beefsteak and melted cheese in a long hoagie roll. A popular regional fast food, it has its roots in the American city of Philadelphia, Pennsylvania.
